name: EgoSuite-Open100K (EgoPro)
tagline: Head + dual wrist-view line of EgoSuite-Open100K: 10,000 h planned (8K h hands + 2K h hands+body); ~1,103 h delivered as MCAP when measured.

annotations.format: MCAP (embedded Protobuf topics: /pose/*, /annotation/*, foxglove.CompressedVideo x4 cameras); card also promises LeRobot v3
annotations.coverageNote: Sampled episodes carry 21-joint hand pose, head/headcam/wrist-cam pose, semantic segments and bad_frame flags; body pose only in EgoProStandard-body.

action_labels.note: Skill tags + start/end time per segment; task_description per episode

hand_pose.note: 21 joints per hand, world-frame position + quaternion (float32)

gaze.note: Right-eye camera pose topic only; no gaze vector

camera_pose.note: Head, headcam and both wrist-camera poses + calibration/extrinsics

depth.note: head_depth declared in metadata but never published in sampled episodes

samples.caption: Project-page sample: logistics task (stacking parcels on a pallet)
LW-VIZ dashboard: head and wrist streams with 3D hand/body skeletons
